attchmntText: Jindal Poly Films Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Jindal Poly Films Limited submitted newspaper publications of its unaudited financial results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, to the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited. The results were published in Financial Express and Jansatta on November 16, 2026. Kothari Industrial Corporation Limited reported that its Board of Directors approved the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 14, 2026. Kaynes Technology India Limited announced that its Board approved the unaudited consolidated financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, on November 14, 2026. Pudumjee Paper Products Limited and AMJ Land Holdings Limited issued notices regarding a special window for the re-lodgement of transfer deeds for physical shares, valid from February 5, 2026, to February 4, 2027. Firestar Diamond International Private Limited, in liquidation, announced an e-auction of assets including natural loose diamonds and gold rings on December 21, 2026.

attchmntText: Jindal Poly Films Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Jindal Poly Films Limited approved standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Limited Review Report from Statutory Auditors Singhi & Co. contains a modified qualified opinion. The qualification relates to the non-accounting of interest on loans and receivables amounting to Rs. 7,113.44 Lakhs for the quarter and Rs. 13,556.54 Lakhs for the half year, due to uncertainty in realization following a fire at a subsidiary. Additionally, the report notes a loan of Rs. 29,200 Lakhs from the holding company to the subsidiary, against which an arbitration notice was received on October 16, 2026, regarding a breach of the Shareholders Agreement dated March 16, 2022. The Board meeting concluded at 07:45 PM IST on November 14, 2026.

attchmntText: Jindal Poly Films Limited has informed the Exchange about Disclosure under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
voiceSummary: Jindal Poly Films Limited executed a standstill agreement on 13 November 2026 with its material subsidiary JPFL Films Private Limited and Project Holdings Fourteen DIFC Limited. The agreement pauses all pending legal proceedings, including a National Company Law Tribunal petition and arbitration, for a period of 12 days to explore an amicable settlement. No consideration is payable under the agreement. The standstill period begins on 13 November 2026 and may be extended by mutual written consent. Existing court orders remain in force during this period. The agreement does not grant special rights such as director appointments or share subscription preferences. The Investor holds approximately 38% of the fully diluted paid-up share capital of JPFL Films. No settlement has been reached as of the disclosure date.
